reviews.title: Peace above it all
reviews.contents: This app was and still is one of the best investments that I made for my third pregnancy. Right from the very beginning of the pregnancy, I knew that I wanted to use the app, and so I did! It was an incredible blessing to be and I would listen to all of the tracks nearly every night and sometimes during the day in quiet moments. Tears of joy and happiness when I used the gratitude and visualisation exercise; it was so effective. When labour began, I immediately used the breathing exercises in the lead up to heading into hospital and the visualisation exercises were a blessing for the car ride. Popped on my noise canceling headphones and let the peaceful atmosphere flow. I was in complete peace and joy in the lead up to meeting my baby. Even though I experienced a placental abruption during labour and I required an emergency caesarean, the peace of God still stayed with me. Thank you for creating this app!

reviews.title: 100 % happy
reviews.contents:
So so so thankful to Tara for creating this apps!! Great apps for a fearful lady preparing for her faith-filled  childbirth!! 

I found this apps in preparation for my 3rd baby’s birth on September 2020. I’ve always been scared to death of childbirth but in 2020, came across supernatural childbirth stories and this apps. Since then, I never stop listening to it as I prepare for my baby’s birth and my goodness I am so thankful!! It works!! 

 I loved listening to all the tracks but the “Encouraging Scriptures” are particularly what get me through. I wrote them all down exactly as in the apps and memorised them all (took me a while to figure out which Bible Translation they are as they are quite a mixture of different translations). 

Now my baby is 7 months old now and I am still listening the “Encouraging Scriptures” everyday. God’s Word help me get through what would have been an ordeal of a lifetime with peace of mind and full of faith in God’s Sovereignty. And indeed God is in control and I am thankful for His Words that are carefully put together and arranged perfectly for a pregnant lady 🤰 

Due to some issues I had when I first bought it, Tara promptly responded my questions and fixed the problem instantly as well. 

So thankful that I have to leave a comment here although not easy with baby 🤪

Bless u Tara !!

reviews.title: 100% recommend for preparing for birth!!
reviews.contents:
I used this app to prepare for the birth of my second child. I had a very difficult labour with my first child and ended up having an epidural with all the added medications that come with it. I struggled so much due to this in the postpartum period and with breastfeeding. I hadn’t learnt to pray and be with God during these most trying but beautiful experiences. 

With my second labour this app helped me practice to rely on God for strength and protection. It helped me pray in my labour which gave me resilience and strength. It helped me focus my mind on God when I was afraid. I was able to have a quicker and easier labour without any medications. It was an incredible experience and I’m so grateful to God for being with me through it.

reviews.title: Listened during birth and pregnancy
reviews.contents: I could not recommend this app more highly, i am telling all my pregnant friends about it. i utilised the tracks during the last trimester of my pregnancy and then during my labour. I actually fell asleep during labour while listening to one of the tracks, that’s how relaxing it was! And once i arrived in hospital i had my favourites from the app playing. Every now and then i would zone into what was being declared and it would always be what i needed to hear in the perfect timing, I felt so close to God and was grateful I could keep renewing my mind on His truth. I had zero pain relief and an amazing labour. So grateful for this resource and for all the Lord did! 🙌🏻

reviews.title: Beyond Perfect! 10/10
reviews.contents: Initially I was a little sceptical as I knew nothing about this app. But I was very curious to see how they would blend Christianity with hypnobirthing, as naturally anything “hypno” I have mentioned to my Christian family has raised a few eyebrows. But this proves as I had hoped that they can go perfectly hand in hand. I am totally blown away by how lovely & well-made the guided tracks are. Incredibly calming, I love that the voice & music are truly just right & not jarring in any way (like some “relaxation” tracks can be!) I am very excited & feel extra confident knowing I have these for my final weeks & then for my birth. If you are aiming for a calm natural birth with God at the helm, you will love having this!! Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Helping me through HG, labour and postpartum 🤍
reviews.contents: This app was incredibly helpful through pregnancy, labour and postpartum. I could not recommend it enough. From 5 weeks pregnant I had sever Hyperemesis Gravidarum up until I gave birth. Medication didn’t help and I was bed ridden in an out of hospital constantly. Listening to the scriptures, prayers and doing the breathing exercises was what got me through. I listened to it multiple times a day and night. It was a way to invite God in when I had no strength. I listened to it during labour and my daughter is 4 months now and I still listen it. Amazing. Thank you so much for making this 🤍🤍

reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.contents: Honestly this app has been such a God send throughout this pregnancy! I am so excited to use it for upcoming birth! I used the early relaxation tracks for first tri fatigue & it was really helpful to get me out of feeling sorry for myself! I was able to enjoy the relaxation! For the last 2 or so months of this pregnancy I have popped headphones in while going to bed & there is never a night it doesn’t put me to sleep! 😆 absolutely love that it’s downloaded so I can pop my phone on aeroplane mode but still have it playing! What a beautiful creation! Thank you 🙏🙏🙏💖

reviews.title: Best pregnancy investment!!
reviews.contents: this app is heaven-sent, regardless of birth plan or how your birth goes. I’ve used it for two pregnancies and now again on my third, 1st being physiological and the 2nd being emergency Cesar. And the way this app has been created to get scripture and encouragement rooted so deeply into your mind and soul, so you’re prepared and excited and trusting God with a continually renewed and strengthened mind - regardless of how baby arrives - is truly such a gift to mamas and families.

reviews.title: God moved through this in my birth
reviews.contents: After a traumatic birth with my first, I really had to trust in God and let go of fear for my birth with my second. God really showed up in a tangible way as soon as I turned the playlist on. Tracks switched at the exact moments it needed to which was absolutely supernatural. Even the midwife asked "who was timing these perfectly" 🙌🏽 would not do another birth without this

reviews.title: Relaxation worked!
reviews.contents: I had this playing my whole labour and it was a blessing. It truly helps you relax and get into your ‘bubble’. The affirmations also helped me during transition period when I thought I could t get through the pain (unmedicated) and she said “surrender” and it reminded me. I made it through and had a beautiful birth experience. Using it again for my second birth.
